videos.title: Selena Gomez Says 10 Years of Rehab Didn't Fix Her, But THIS Did
videos.description:
Selena Gomez stopped waiting for the hard part of her life to go away. She made it a friend instead.

In this clip, Selena Gomez and Jay Shetty talk about what actually changed after four treatment centres, not a cure, but the moment she stopped trying to fix herself and started learning how to live with herself.

Selena opens up about watching her documentary back and not recognising the girl on screen, the small changes she makes when she feels a low coming, and what she does when someone else tries to tell her story before she can.

Learn about the difference between being strong for other people and being strong for yourself, and why the moment she stopped needing to look put together is the moment people finally saw her.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

videos.title: Benevolent Uses of AI to Improve Your Life
videos.description:
Dr. Fei-Fei Li, PhD, is a professor of computer science at Stanford University and a pioneer and expert in artificial intelligence (AI).

We discuss how AI can be used safely and effectively to extend human capabilities – not just to search for information but specifically to increase human intelligence and creativity.

We also discuss how humans collaborating with AI and robots can transform human health and our experience of life for the better.

And we cover what makes AI fundamentally different from human cognition, and why your intuition and unique experiences are not replicable by AI or machines.

Both AI enthusiasts and skeptics will benefit from the information and tools Dr. Fei-Fei Li shares in this episode.
